description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Things service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends multiple configuration interfaces and includes a method to determine if incoming messages should be logged, along with an inner enum for known configuration values.

classes.name: ThingsConfig
classes.description: Interface for configuration settings of the Things service, extending multiple configuration interfaces and containing an inner enum for known config values.

classes.name: ThingsConfig.ThingsConfigValue
classes.description: Enum listing known configuration path expressions and their default values, implementing KnownConfigValue.

methods.name: isLogIncomingMessages
methods.description: Indicates whether all incoming messages should be logged for message tracing.

methods.name: getThingConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings specific to thing entities.
